origin: Synthesized locally by generate.py in this directory; no third-party audio. Tone plan and tolerance categories follow ITU-T Recommendations Q.23 and Q.24 (11/1988). Exact receiver boundaries are explicitly attributed to the AT&T example column of Q.24 Annex A.

determinism.sample_format: 8000 Hz, 16-bit signed little-endian PCM, mono WAV
determinism.noise_prng: LCG state updated as (1664525*state + 1013904223) mod 2^32 with initial state 0x6D2B79F5; every noise file resets to this state
determinism.regeneration: Run python3 generate.py from this directory; committed outputs must match by SHA-256 byte-for-byte.

fixture_policy.mandatory_non_operation_duration: 20 ms, safely within the selected AT&T <=23 ms non-operation region
fixture_policy.gray_duration: 25 ms, explicitly indeterminate because it lies between 23 and 40 ms
fixture_policy.mandatory_operation_duration: 45 ms, above the selected AT&T >=40 ms operation boundary
fixture_policy.active_tone_snr: Power ratio is measured over the 800 tone-on samples in every 1600-sample key slot; the channel mask is shifted by its exact 50-sample group delay. Noise remains present over the complete file.
fixture_policy.key_set: The Q.23 16-key order 123A456B789C*0#D is retained. No separate 12-key conformance set is asserted before calibrated levels, receiver thresholds, impairment cases, and reject labels are frozen.

rights: The generated audio, CSV, manifest, and provenance contain no copied ITU prose, tables, figures, or third-party recordings. ITU recommendations are cited only as specifications and remain ITU-copyrighted.
license_review: No third-party audio license is required for these locally synthesized fixtures.
